description: Create a new standalone Pine v5 strategy file smc_fvg_strategy.pine (title 'SMC - FVG Strategy | Emmanuel') by copying the full structure + FVG-in-BOS/CHoCH engine from smc_fvg.pine and adding a trading layer. Leave smc_fvg.pine UNTOUCHED (Pine cannot be both indicator and strategy in one script, and the user keeps the pure indicator). On a BOS/CHoCH confirmed at candle close, for the FVG highlighted within that break, place a LIMIT order at the FVG's NEAR (proximal) edge, with SL/TP in points, plus a permanent split-rectangle projection. Reuse the existing Internal/Swing/Both gate so trades fire only when that structure type's FVG is generated. Self-contained single feature (no dependencies).
steps: Copy smc_fvg.pine to smc_fvg_strategy.pine at repo root (preserve all existing structure/FVG engine code, inputs, types, functions, execution and alerts).

Change the declaration on line 2 from indicator('SMC - FVG | Emmanuel', 'SMC - FVG', overlay=true, max_labels_count=500, max_lines_count=500, max_boxes_count=500) to strategy('SMC - FVG Strategy | Emmanuel', 'SMC - FVG Strat', overlay=true, pyramiding=100, max_labels_count=500, max_lines_count=500, max_boxes_count=500, default_qty_type=strategy.fixed, default_qty_value=1, calc_on_every_tick=false). Keep default bar-close order processing (entries decided on candle close).

Add a new input group STRATEGY_GROUP = 'Strategy' with inputs: slPointsInput = input.float(300, 'Stop Loss (points)', group=STRATEGY_GROUP, minval=0); tpPointsInput = input.float(5000, 'Take Profit (points)', group=STRATEGY_GROUP, minval=0); orderQtyInput = input.float(1, 'Order Size (contracts)', group=STRATEGY_GROUP, minval=0); maxOrdersInput = input.int(100, 'Max Concurrent Orders', group=STRATEGY_GROUP, minval=1, maxval=100). Add a PROJECTION_GROUP = 'Trade Projection' with inputs: showProjectionInput = input.bool(true, 'Show Projection', group=PROJECTION_GROUP); tpZoneColorInput = input.color(color.new(#2962ff, 80), 'TP Zone', group=PROJECTION_GROUP, inline='proj'); slZoneColorInput = input.color(color.new(#9c27b0, 80), 'SL Zone', group=PROJECTION_GROUP, inline='proj'); entryLineColorInput = input.color(color.new(#787b86, 0), 'Entry Line', group=PROJECTION_GROUP); projectionWidthInput = input.int(30, 'Projection Width (bars)', group=PROJECTION_GROUP, minval=1).

Add a new UDT after the structFvg type: type tradeOrder with fields string id, float entry, float sl, float tp, bool isLong, box tpBox, box slBox, line entryLine, bool filled = false. Add var array<tradeOrder> tradeOrders = array.new<tradeOrder>() and var int orderCounter = 0 to the VARIABLES section.

Define a void function placeStrategyOrder(bool isBull, float nearEdge) BEFORE displayStructure (alongside highlightStructFvg/maintainStructFvgs, since displayStructure calls it in the same path). Logic: guard with `if not na(nearEdge) and tradeOrders.size() < maxOrdersInput`. Compute entry=nearEdge; for long (isBull true): sl = entry - slPointsInput, tp = entry + tpPointsInput; for short: sl = entry + slPointsInput, tp = entry - tpPointsInput. Build a unique id: orderCounter += 1, string id = (isBull ? 'L' : 'S') + str.tostring(orderCounter). Call strategy.entry(id, isBull ? strategy.long : strategy.short, qty=orderQtyInput, limit=entry). Attach exits: strategy.exit(id + '_x', from_entry=id, stop=sl, limit=tp). Draw the projection (see next step) and push a tradeOrder onto tradeOrders. End function with trailing `true`.

Inside placeStrategyOrder (or a helper drawProjection defined before it), when showProjectionInput is true, draw the split-rectangle projection using xloc.bar_index from the current bar (right = bar_index + projectionWidthInput): TP zone box from entry to tp filled with tpZoneColorInput; SL zone box from entry to sl filled with slZoneColorInput; a dotted horizontal entry line at price=entry using entryLineColorInput and line.style_dotted. Because tp(5000) >> sl(300), the TP box is much larger (matches the user's image). Store the box/line ids in the tradeOrder. IMPORTANT: projections are NEVER deleted (item 3: keep drawn even when trade closes/matches). Ensure box top/bottom use math.max/math.min of the two prices so box.new gets a valid top>bottom.

In displayStructure, in the BULLISH break branch, right where `if bullMakeFvg` calls highlightStructFvg(p_ivot.barIndex, true): after that highlight call, place the order using the near edge of the FVG that was just pushed. The near/proximal edge for a bullish FVG (long) is the FVG TOP; for bearish (short) it is the FVG BOTTOM. Read the last pushed structFvg from structFvgs (if structFvgs.size() > 0, get structFvgs.last()) and use f.top for long. Call placeStrategyOrder(true, f.top). Guard so the order is placed only when a new FVG was actually pushed (compare structFvgs.size() before/after the highlight call, or have highlightStructFvg's push be the signal). Mirror in the BEARISH branch: after `if bearMakeFvg` calls highlightStructFvg(p_ivot.barIndex, false), place placeStrategyOrder(false, f.bottom) using the last pushed structFvg's bottom.

Ensure the reused gate is exact: trades fire ONLY inside the same `if bullMakeFvg` / `if bearMakeFvg` blocks that gate highlightStructFvg. bullMakeFvg/bearMakeFvg already combine showStructFvgInput + structFvgSourceInput (Internal/Swing/Both). Do NOT add a separate trade-enable toggle. Turning off internal or swing FVGs via structFvgSourceInput must disable the corresponding trades automatically.

Do a full static self-review pass: strategy() declaration valid, pyramiding=100, generous max_*_count, unique ids, definition-before-use (placeStrategyOrder and any drawProjection defined before displayStructure), all new void functions end with trailing `true`, no break/continue, backwards-for loops guarded, box.new gets top>=bottom, color.new used correctly, projections never deleted.
Commit smc_fvg_strategy.pine on branch feat/smc-fvg-strategy with a descriptive message. Do NOT stage or modify any other file (leave smc_fvg.pine untouched).
acceptance_criteria: smc_fvg_strategy.pine exists at repo root and starts with `//@version=5` then `strategy('SMC - FVG Strategy | Emmanuel', ...` with overlay=true and pyramiding=100.
smc_fvg.pine is byte-for-byte unchanged (git shows no modification to it).
The file contains SL/TP point inputs defaulting to 300 and 5000 respectively, an order-size input, and a max-concurrent-orders input defaulting to 100.
A tradeOrder UDT and var array<tradeOrder> tradeOrders exist; placeStrategyOrder is defined before displayStructure and is called inside both the bullMakeFvg and bearMakeFvg gated blocks.
For a bullish break the limit entry uses the FVG top (proximal edge) and for a bearish break the FVG bottom; long SL=entry-slPoints/TP=entry+tpPoints, short SL=entry+slPoints/TP=entry-tpPoints.
A split-rectangle projection (TP zone box + SL zone box + dotted entry line) is drawn per order using input colors, and is never deleted on close/match.
Order placement respects tradeOrders.size() < maxOrdersInput (hard cap 100) and each entry has a unique string id.
No separate trade-enable toggle exists; the Internal/Swing/Both selector alone gates trades via the reused bullMakeFvg/bearMakeFvg gate.
All new void functions end with a trailing `true`; no break/continue; definition-before-use ordering preserved.
verification: Static self-review only (Pine cannot compile locally). Read smc_fvg_strategy.pine end-to-end and confirm each acceptance criterion.
Run `git diff --name-only feat/smc-fvg-extract` and confirm only smc_fvg_strategy.pine (and .agents task files) changed, NOT smc_fvg.pine.

grep the new file to confirm: exactly one `strategy(` declaration and zero `indicator(` declarations; `pyramiding = 100` (or pyramiding=100) present; `strategy.entry` and `strategy.exit` present with unique id construction; placeStrategyOrder defined before displayStructure (line number of def < line number of first call).
Confirm placeStrategyOrder call sites are only within the `if bullMakeFvg` and `if bearMakeFvg` blocks.
findings: V1 REVIEW FOLLOW-UP (2026-09-11-192217-review.md): addressed all 4 issues. ISSUE #1 (cap was LIFETIME not CONCURRENT) FIXED: tradeOrders was append-only so `tradeOrders.size() < maxOrdersInput` became a lifetime budget that permanently blocked new orders after 100 placements. Added orderIsOpen(id) helper (iterates strategy.opentrades / strategy.opentrades.entry_id) and a pruneTradeOrders() void fn, both defined before displayStructure (orderIsOpen line ~357, pruneTradeOrders ~371) and called each bar in the execution section right after maintainStructFvgs() (line ~475). pruneTradeOrders walks tradeOrders backwards (guarded by size>0), sets t.filled:=true once an order's position is open, and removes entries that are filled AND no longer open (i.e. the trade has closed) so the cap now counts only LIVE orders = pending limit orders (not filled, not open) + currently-open positions. Removal is from the cap-tracking array ONLY; the projection boxes/lines are NOT deleted (Pine keeps box/line drawings on the chart even after the reference is dropped from the array), so user answer #3 (projections never removed) and answer #4 (pending orders stay open indefinitely - we never cancel/expire, we only free a slot after a real close) are both preserved. Label 'Max Concurrent Orders' now matches behavior. ISSUE #4 (dead `filled` field) FIXED as part of #1: filled is now actively set by pruneTradeOrders and drives the close-detection/slot-freeing logic; its doc comment updated. ISSUE #2 (only ONE FVG ordered per break, not 'all') NOT CHANGED - BY DESIGN: matches the user's authoritative clarifying answer #1 (entry = FVG near edge, singular) and the existing highlightStructFvg engine which highlights the LAST same-direction FVG in the break leg. The task scope forbids changing the FVG detection engine; single-FVG-per-break is the confirmed spec. ISSUE #3 (points not scaled by mintick) NOT CHANGED - INTENTIONAL ASSUMPTION re-affirmed for user: SL/TP are raw price units (long tp=entry+tpPointsInput etc.), NOT multiplied by syminfo.mintick. On instruments where 1 point != 1 price unit (many futures/forex) the user may want mintick scaling; left as raw-points default per guidance, flagged for user confirmation. Adding scaling would require a user-facing option to avoid breaking the raw-points default and was deliberately not added without confirmation. ORIGINAL V1 IMPLEMENTATION (unchanged below): Created smc_fvg_strategy.pine by copying smc_fvg.pine (388 lines) and adding a trading layer; smc_fvg.pine left byte-for-byte unchanged (verified via `git diff --name-only feat/smc-fvg-extract -- smc_fvg.pine` = empty). Declaration changed to strategy('SMC - FVG Strategy | Emmanuel', 'SMC - FVG Strat', overlay=true, pyramiding=100, max_labels/lines/boxes_count=500, default_qty_type=strategy.fixed, default_qty_value=1, calc_on_every_tick=false). Added Strategy inputs (SL 300, TP 5000, order size 1, max orders 100) and Projection inputs (show toggle, TP zone #2962ff@80, SL zone #9c27b0@80, entry line #787b86@0, projection width 30 bars). Added tradeOrder UDT after structFvg, plus var array<tradeOrder> tradeOrders and var int orderCounter. placeStrategyOrder(isBull, nearEdge) defined before displayStructure (line 329, called at 393/424): computes entry=nearEdge, long sl=entry-slPts/tp=entry+tpPts, short mirrored; builds unique id ('L'/'S'+counter); calls strategy.entry(limit=entry) + strategy.exit(id+'_x', stop, limit); draws split-rectangle projection (TP box + SL box via math.max/min for valid top>=bottom + dotted entry line) stored in the tradeOrder and NEVER deleted; guarded by tradeOrders.size() < maxOrdersInput; ends with trailing `true`. Order placement wired into the existing bullMakeFvg/bearMakeFvg gated blocks in displayStructure using a size-before/after check on structFvgs so an order fires only when a new FVG was actually pushed; near edge = structFvgs.last().top for long, .bottom for short. No separate trade-enable toggle: the Internal/Swing/Both selector (structFvgSourceInput) alone gates trades, so disabling internal or swing FVGs disables their trades automatically. VERIFICATION: static self-review only (no local Pine compiler in this environment, per context.json); confirmed exactly one strategy( declaration and zero indicator(, def-before-use ordering, void functions end with `true`, no break/continue, backwards-for guarded (reused existing span>=2 guard), box.new gets top>=bottom, color.new used to set (not stack) transparency. ASSUMPTION TO CONFIRM: 'points' treated as raw price units (long tp = entry + tpPointsInput), NOT multiplied by syminfo.mintick. On instruments where 1 point != 1 price unit (e.g. many futures/forex), the user may need mintick scaling; flagged for user confirmation. The user must paste smc_fvg_strategy.pine into TradingView to confirm it compiles and behaves.
